summary: SAKURA SPA Nipponbashi is an outcall men’s esthetic (massage) service in the Nipponbashi area of Osaka, Japan. We have no shop: a female therapist visits you at a hotel we arrange, or at a location of your choice. Open 12:00 to 05:00 the next morning, by reservation only, though same-day bookings are accepted when a therapist is free. The Luxury Lymph course costs ¥14,000 for 60 minutes up to ¥32,000 for 180 minutes (tax included), plus ¥3,000 for the hotel or travel. Payment is cash only. Book anytime on LINE, where we assist in English, Chinese and Korean. Guests must be 18 or older.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: FAQ
faq.lead: The questions guests ask us most often, answered. Anything else, just ask on LINE.

items.q: What kind of service is SAKURA SPA?
items.a: An outcall men’s esthetic service in the Nipponbashi area of Osaka. We have no shop. A female therapist visits a hotel we arrange, or a location of your choice, and gives a luxury oil lymphatic treatment. We do not offer any sexual services.
12:00 until 05:00 the following morning. Reservations and enquiries on LINE are accepted 24 hours a day.

The Luxury Lymph course is ¥14,000 for 60 min, ¥16,000 for 90 min, ¥20,000 for 120 min, ¥26,000 for 150 min and ¥32,000 for 180 min (tax included). Extensions are ¥6,000 per 30 min. Nomination is ¥1,000, repeat nomination ¥2,000. A hotel or travel charge of ¥3,000 is added. There is no membership fee.
Cash only. We cannot accept credit cards, e-money or QR payments. Please pay the therapist directly on the day.
Yes. Same-day and last-minute bookings are accepted whenever a therapist is free. Message us on LINE with the time you have in mind.

items.q: How do I make a reservation?
items.a: On LINE, 24 hours a day. Tell us your preferred date and time, course length, and where you would like the treatment — including whether you would like us to arrange the hotel. Japanese speakers can also book by phone.

items.q: Do I need to book the hotel myself?
items.a: Normally we arrange the hotel for you. We can also visit your home or the hotel you are already staying in — just ask on LINE. We serve the Naniwa and Chuo wards of Osaka and the surrounding Nipponbashi area.

Please tell us on LINE as early as you can. Cancellations made within 10 minutes of your reservation time are charged at 100% of the course fee. Once the therapist has entered the room, the booking can no longer be cancelled.

items.q: Can I use the service if I don’t speak Japanese?
items.a: Yes. We handle LINE bookings in English, Chinese (simplified and traditional) and Korean, and this site is available in five languages. Phone bookings are in Japanese only.

items.q: What do I need to prepare?
items.a: Nothing in particular. When we arrange the hotel, the towels and amenities in the room are yours to use. We recommend taking a shower before the treatment.
Yes. Browse the therapist list and the schedule, and name the therapist you would like. Nomination is ¥1,000, repeat nomination ¥2,000.
You must be 18 or older to use our service. We may ask you to confirm your age.
